definitions.gloss: detailed report; full account; in-depth coverage
definitions.explanation: A thorough and detailed report or account of an event, situation, or topic. Often used in journalism and official reporting.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}の{詳報|しょうほう}が{届|とど}いた。
examples.english: A detailed report on the incident arrived.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}{結果|けっか}の{詳報|しょうほう}は{明日|あした}の{朝刊|ちょうかん}に{掲載|けいさい}される。
examples.english: The detailed election results will be published in tomorrow's morning edition.

examples.japanese: {現地|げんち}の{記者|きしゃ}が{送|おく}ってきた{詳報|しょうほう}によると、{被害|ひがい}は{当初|とうしょ}の{予想|よそう}より{大|おお}きいようだ。
examples.english: According to the detailed report sent by the correspondent on the ground, the damage appears greater than initially expected.

notes:
Compound noun: {詳|しょう} (detailed) + {報|ほう} (report, news). Primarily used in journalism and formal reporting contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {詳報|しょうほう}を{伝|つた}える (to deliver a detailed report)
- {詳報|しょうほう}が{入|はい}る (a detailed report comes in)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {速報|そくほう}: breaking news, flash report — emphasizes speed over detail
- {詳報|しょうほう}: detailed report — emphasizes thoroughness and completeness
